requirement.description: The __setstate__ method in URL class is not correctly handling the legacy pickle format. The method assumes that state is always a tuple with a dictionary, but it can also be a tuple of 5 elements directly.
requirement.contract: The __setstate__ method should properly handle both legacy pickle format (tuple of 5 elements) and default style pickle format (tuple with dictionary).

requirement.description: The __setstate__ method in URL class is not correctly handling the legacy pickle format. The method tries to access attributes like _scheme that don't exist on the URL object.
requirement.contract: The __setstate__ method should properly handle legacy pickle format by correctly setting the internal _val attribute.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method incorrectly encodes the suffix when the URL path already contains encoded characters, causing double encoding.
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should properly handle already encoded path components without double encoding them.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method incorrectly validates the suffix input. It raises "Slash in name is not allowed" instead of "Invalid suffix" when the suffix contains a slash.
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should validate suffix properly and raise the correct error message for invalid suffixes.
